title: Survey Algernon
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Survey the many locations connected to Algernon and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Survey the many locations connected to Algernon and return to Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

Oh hello. Who are you? You don't look like Sir Henry. I asked for Henry to help survey Algernon, but since he refuses to help out, I will have to ask you. Have you heard of the Kingdom Dissallowance Act? Townston wanted to ensure that its energy drink business is the best seller, so the King's Board of Trustees started Dissallowance to prevent competition. It hasn't worked out too well, and the kids are complaining because their parents aren't giving them any allowance -- that became illegal too because of a loophole.

Well, we need money somehow, so I need you to get down there and survey the dungeon.

I'm tired of this conversation. Can we talk about something else? I'm going home.

Turn-in:

Oh hello. Who are you? You don't look like Sir Henry. If you see Sir Henry, can you give him this King's Coin to pay him for surveying Algernon? Thanks. Oh and also mention that I might need his help again in a few levels.

Objectives:

  • Survey the Orok Outpost
  • Survey Capwn's Family Ratstaurant
  • Survey Not the Rumored Refinery
  • Survey Not the Mutant Operation Center
  • Survey Little Dew Valley Forest
  • Survey Porthole Laboratories

Level range: 3–20
